headline: Q2FY27: Record Pre-Sales; Strong Cash Generations

highlights: Result Update 09th November, 2026 BUY Target Price 750 Arvind SmartSpaces Ltd Real Estate vv 1 Q2FY27: Record Pre-Sales; Strong Cash Generations Recommendation Rationale • Strong Pre-sales with Upward Revision in Guidance: Arvind SmartSpaces delivered a strong operational performance in H1FY27, with bookings growing 120% YoY to Rs 1,338 Cr, achieving nearly 90% of its FY26 full-year bookings within six months.

Management has raised FY27 booking guidance to Rs 2,600-2,700 Cr, implying 70-75% YoY growth, reflecting strong demand visibility and an expanding launch pipeline. • Diversified Geographical Presence: Arvind SmartSpaces is benefiting from its expanding presence across Ahmedabad, Bengaluru and MMR, reducing dependence on its traditional Gujarat market.
Sustenance sales have also gained traction, with H1FY27 sustenance bookings already exceeding the previous year’s full-year achievement of Rs 600 Cr, according to management.

The upcoming launch pipeline of four projects worth Rs 2,200-2,500 Cr, including two in Mumbai and two in Bengaluru, provides additional visibility for sustained growth. • Disciplined Cash Allocation & Balance Sheet Strength: The company continues to follow disciplined capital allocation, maintaining a 25% IRR hurdle rate for new project acquisitions.
